observations: Reset prompts have two title lines and Yes/Cancel. Cancel closes settings; Back returns to the Reset menu.
Settings & Data and Initialize All return to HOME. Language is preserved.
Variable Memory preserves settings, registered functions and sampled Matrix, Vector, Statistics, Spreadsheet and Number Line data. It clears scalar variable and answer memory.
Settings & Data clears sampled Matrix, Vector, Statistics, Spreadsheet and Number Line data, registered functions and Normal PD parameters.
Selecting Calculate again from HOME clears PreAns while keeping Ans and scalar variables.
In Normal PD, SETTINGS opens on parameter rows and is ignored on Execute. Numeric input on Execute is ignored. Up/down wrap between the first parameter and Execute.
